answer: Orchard-Seeded Identity Slots. Each agent gets one identity slot derived from a seed committed at registration; the network enforces one slot per seed by requiring the seed to solve a small random challenge whose solution orbit is checkable but scarce. A comet-shaped dependency graph records each slot's seed lineage, so any duplicate lineage path is exposed publicly. A prism tag encodes the seed into every signed message, letting peers reject colliding seeds.
